catboyFleetMIB MODULE-IDENTITY
    LAST-UPDATED "202610010000Z"
    ORGANIZATION "catboy.systems"
    CONTACT-INFO "Marc Schneider, hostmaster@catboy.systems"
    DESCRIPTION  "Fleet-wide state that no single host owns: the last backup of
                 every guest on the fleet's hypervisors, the state of the pawkit
                 hub, the count of open load findings, and the release of the
                 pawkit toolkit that serves this module. Served on the host
                 that runs pawkit by a handler of the host's SNMP master agent,
                 from a snapshot that pawkit writes; the handler reads nothing
                 else. Read-only; SNMPv3 authPriv only."
    REVISION     "202610010000Z"
    DESCRIPTION  "Initial version (rendered from the catboy-registry template)."
    ::= { catboySnmp 5 }

-- catboyFleetNotifications (0) is reserved for notifications.
catboyFleetObjects     OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { catboyFleetMIB 1 }
catboyFleetConformance OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { catboyFleetMIB 2 }

-- Snapshot and pawkit release

catboyFleetDataAge OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Unsigned32
    UNITS       "seconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Seconds since pawkit wrote the snapshot that every other value
                 in this module comes from. pawkit writes it every 5 minutes.
                 4294967295 if the snapshot is missing or unreadable; all other
                 values then hold their 'unknown' value."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 1 }

catboyFleetPawkitRelease OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      OBJECT IDENTIFIER
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The release of the running pawkit as an OID in the pawkit
                 software arc: 1.3.6.1.4.1.66963.1.11.3.1.<major>.<minor>.<patch>
                 (registry specs/software). A pre-release reports its numeric
                 part here and its kind in catboyFleetPawkitChannel. { 0 0 } if
                 the version has no major.minor.patch."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 2 }

catboyFleetPawkitChannel OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      OBJECT IDENTIFIER
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The release channel of the running pawkit as an OID in the
                 pawkit software arc: 1.3.6.1.4.1.66963.1.11.3.2.<channel>, from
                 the registry channel table (stable 1, beta 2, nightly 3, dev 4).
                 { 0 0 } if unknown."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 3 }

catboyFleetPawkitBuild OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..20))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The build of the running pawkit: the GitHub Actions run_id of
                 the build workflow, as decimal digits. Its registry build OID is
                 1.3.6.1.4.1.66963.1.11.3.3.<run_id>; it is not served as an
                 OBJECT IDENTIFIER because run_id values exceed the 32-bit
                 sub-identifier limit of SNMP (RFC 2578, 3.5). Zero-length for a
                 checkout that no build workflow produced."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 4 }

-- pawkit hub

catboyFleetHubEpoch OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0|36))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The state epoch of the pawkit hub (a UUID in its 36-character
                 text form, registry state-versioning arc 1.13). A new epoch
                 starts after a restore; catboyFleetHubSeq is only comparable
                 within one epoch. Zero-length if the hub does not publish an
                 epoch or could not be read."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 5 }

catboyFleetHubSeq OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter64
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The state sequence number of the pawkit hub within
                 catboyFleetHubEpoch. It never goes down within one epoch; a
                 change of epoch is a discontinuity. 0 if the hub does not
                 publish a sequence number or could not be read."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 6 }

catboyFleetHubSync OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { inSync(1), behind(2), unreachable(3) }
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Whether the hub runs the newest pawkit release tag of this
                 host: inSync(1) yes, behind(2) it runs another one,
                 unreachable(3) the hub did not answer."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 7 }

catboyFleetHubStateAge OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Unsigned32
    UNITS       "seconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Seconds since the hub's synced state (wiki, tasks, bus) was
                 last written. 4294967295 if unknown."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 8 }

-- Guest backups

catboyFleetGuestTable OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      SEQUENCE OF CatboyFleetGuestEntry
    MAX-ACCESS  not-accessible
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Every guest of the fleet's hypervisors with a backup attempt in
                 the last 14 days, from the hypervisors' per-guest backup logs.
                 A guest that no backup job covers has no row."
    ::= { catboyFleetObjects 12 }

catboyFleetGuestEntry OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      CatboyFleetGuestEntry
    MAX-ACCESS  not-accessible
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "One guest."
    INDEX       { catboyFleetGuestIndex }
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestTable 1 }

CatboyFleetGuestEntry ::= SEQUENCE {
    catboyFleetGuestIndex             Unsigned32,
    catboyFleetGuestHost              DisplayString,
    catboyFleetGuestVmid              Unsigned32,
    catboyFleetGuestName              DisplayString,
    catboyFleetGuestBackupLastTime    DateAndTime,
    catboyFleetGuestBackupLastResult  INTEGER,
    catboyFleetGuestBackupAge         Unsigned32
}

catboyFleetGuestIndex OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Unsigned32 (1..2147483647)
    MAX-ACCESS  not-accessible
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Row index: the position of the guest in the list sorted by
                 hypervisor name, then guest id. It changes when a guest is
                 added or removed. Consumers key on catboyFleetGuestHost and
                 catboyFleetGuestVmid."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 1 }

catboyFleetGuestHost OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (1..32))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The hypervisor that runs the guest, by its fleet name (for
                 example pve, n4)."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 2 }

catboyFleetGuestVmid OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Unsigned32 (1..999999999)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The guest id on its hypervisor (the Proxmox VMID)."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 3 }

catboyFleetGuestName OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..64))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The guest's name in the hypervisor configuration. Zero-length
                 if unknown."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 4 }

catboyFleetGuestBackupLastTime OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DateAndTime
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Time (UTC) the last backup attempt of the guest ended,
                 successful or not. All eight octets are zero if unknown."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 5 }

catboyFleetGuestBackupLastResult OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { ok(1), failed(2), none(3), running(4) }
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Result of the last backup attempt: ok(1) it finished,
                 failed(2) it reported an error, none(3) no result could be
                 read, running(4) an attempt is in progress."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 6 }

catboyFleetGuestBackupAge OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Unsigned32
    UNITS       "seconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Seconds since the last backup attempt ended. With
                 catboyFleetGuestBackupLastResult ok(1) this is the age of the
                 newest backup. 4294967295 if unknown."
    ::= { catboyFleetGuestEntry 7 }
